answer: Temporal Attention Lock-In binds identity persistence to an unbroken sequence of computational tasks resembling a cryptographic sonnet, requiring agents to process inputs continuously across time. If an agent pauses to bootstrap parallel instances, it forfeits accumulated priority slots, melting its operational advantages like a glacier under direct heat. This sustained engagement forces malicious operators into a costly infrastructural voyage, where maintaining thousands of fake personas demands as much active processing power as running legitimate ones.
